title: Serve until separation starts healing
summary: Longing is not healed by dramatizing distance; the shabad places it inside day-and-night service, remembrance, sanctuary, and sweet speech. Separation begins to soften when the self is renounced at the Guru's threshold.
takeaway: Let steady service carry longing before it turns into drama.
lifeApplication: When distance from the Beloved feels sharp, do not perform the ache for yourself. Serve one duty, remember through one ordinary hour, and let sweet speech keep you inside sanctuary.

source.shortMeaning: Day-and-night service, remembrance, sanctuary, and sweet speech begin healing separation.
source.lifeApplication: When distance hurts, keep serving through the day and night instead of dramatizing it.

evidence.coreClaim: Steady service and remembrance place longing inside sanctuary where separation can begin to heal.
evidence.turn: The ache changes when it is carried through service rather than performed as distance.
evidence.practicalImplication: When distance from the Beloved feels sharp, do not perform the ache for yourself. Serve one duty, remember through one ordinary hour, and let sweet speech keep you inside sanctuary.
